title: Anupam Rasayan Buys Bliss GVS, With a ₹1 Option Attached

shorts.title: The ₹1 option behind Anupam's Bliss deal
Who paid for Anupam's Bliss GVS takeover?

beats.say: On the twenty eighth of September, Anupam Rasayan said it had paid for a forty eight percent controlling stake in Bliss G V S Pharma, at two hundred and ninety nine rupees a share.
beats.cap: On 28 September, Anupam Rasayan said it had paid for a 48.2% controlling stake in Bliss GVS Pharma, at ₹299 a share.
cues: On 28 September, Anupam Rasayan said it had paid for a 48.2% controlling
stake in Bliss GVS Pharma, at ₹299 a share.

beats.say: Most of the money came from outside investors led by Bain Capital. And a filing from the twenty third of September shows what can happen if the debt goes bad: a company called Pure Bliss can buy the whole stake for one rupee.
beats.cap: Most of the money came from outside investors led by Bain Capital. And a filing from 23 September shows what can happen if the debt goes bad: a company called Purebliss can buy the whole stake for ₹1.
cues: Most of the money came from outside investors led by Bain Capital.
And a filing from 23 September shows what can happen if the debt goes bad:
a company called Purebliss can buy the whole stake for ₹1.

beats.say: This is the story of a takeover funded mostly by other people's money, told only from the companies' own filings.
beats.cap: This is the story of a takeover funded mostly by other people's money, told only from the companies' own filings.
cues: This is the story of a takeover funded mostly by other people's money,
told only from the companies' own filings.

beats.say: Bliss G V S's board recorded the change. Anupam Rasayan and its subsidiary Mates are now promoters, holding forty seven point nine five percent of the company.
beats.cap: Bliss GVS's board recorded the change. Anupam Rasayan and its subsidiary Mates are now promoters, holding 5,09,86,264 shares, or 47.95% of the company.
cues: Bliss GVS's board recorded the change.
Anupam Rasayan and its subsidiary Mates are now promoters,
holding 5,09,86,264 shares, or 47.95% of the company.

beats.say: The managing director, Narsimha Kamath, resigned, and three new directors joined. The outgoing promoters, who held thirty four point eight two percent, move to the public category.
beats.cap: The managing director, Narsimha Kamath, resigned, and three new directors joined. The outgoing promoters, who held 34.82%, move to the public category.
cues: The managing director, Narsimha Kamath, resigned,
and three new directors joined.
The outgoing promoters, who held 34.82%, move to the public category.

beats.say: At two hundred and ninety nine rupees, the shares bought from the sellers cost about one thousand five hundred and twenty four crore rupees. Anupam says that is about twenty four times trailing earnings.
beats.cap: At ₹299, the shares bought from the sellers cost about ₹1,524 crore. Anupam says that is "approximately 24x LTM earnings".
cues: At ₹299, the shares bought from the sellers cost about ₹1,524 crore.
Anupam says that is "approximately 24x LTM earnings".

beats.say: The open offer barely moved. Asked about it in August, management said the shares tendered were a very, very small number.
beats.cap: The open offer barely moved. Asked about it in August, management said the shares tendered were "a very, very small number".
cues: The open offer barely moved.

very small number".

beats.say: Bliss G V S was founded in nineteen eighty four. It sells branded medicines, more than one hundred and fifty brands, made at six plants in Maharashtra.
beats.cap: Bliss GVS was founded in 1984. It sells branded formulations, "more than 150 brands", made at six plants in Maharashtra.
cues: Bliss GVS was founded in 1984.
It sells branded formulations, "more than 150 brands",
made at six plants in Maharashtra.

beats.say: It is growing. In the June quarter its revenue was two hundred and eighty five point six crore rupees, up thirty eight percent, and net profit was fifty one point four crore.
beats.cap: It is growing. In Q1 FY27 its consolidated revenue was ₹285.58 crore, up 38%, and net profit was ₹51.37 crore.
cues: It is growing.
In Q1 FY27 its consolidated revenue was ₹285.58 crore, up 38%,
and net profit was ₹51.37 crore.

beats.say: Its plants run at about thirty percent capacity. Management expects that to rise to sixty to seventy percent. That is an expectation, not a result.
beats.cap: Its plants run at "approximately 30% capacity". Management expects that to rise to 60% to 70%. That is an expectation, not a result.
cues: Its plants run at "approximately 30% capacity".
Management expects that to rise to 60% to 70%.
That is an expectation, not a result.

beats.cap: Anupam calls Bliss the third step. Tanfac, bought in 2022, secures raw materials. Jayhawk, in Kansas, gave it a plant in the United States. Bliss takes it into finished medicines.

beats.say: The group says the combined business would have revenue of more than four thousand crore rupees and E B I T D A of about eight hundred and thirty four crore.

beats.cap: The funding was a ₹300 crore debt, and about ₹1,450 crore from outside investors, through non-voting instruments. About 83% of the money is not Anupam's.

beats.say: The September filings show the structure. Mates issues up to three hundred crore of secured debentures. They are backed by a pledge of all Mates shares, a pledge of Anupam's fifteen percent stake in Pure Bliss, and a guarantee from Anupam.
beats.cap: The September filings show the structure. Mates issues up to ₹300 crore of secured debentures. They are backed by a pledge of all Mates shares, a pledge of Anupam's 15% stake in Purebliss, and a guarantee from Anupam.
cues: The September filings show the structure.
Mates issues up to ₹300 crore of secured debentures.
They are backed by a pledge of all Mates shares,
a pledge of Anupam's 15% stake in Purebliss, and a guarantee from Anupam.

beats.say: The rest is to come through equity like instruments issued to Pure Bliss Pharma Solutions. The filings do not say who owns the rest of Pure Bliss, or on what terms it receives the money.

beats.say: The focus moat is cost advantage through integration. Owning each step, from fluorine chemistry to finished tablets, is meant to lower cost and let Anupam offer customers more of the chain.
